look: a female draconian, a dragon-folk with orange-red scales, a horned reptile head with a broad blunt snout, and a heavy muscular build

cheek_spikes.label: face
cheek_spikes.guide: A short pale spike points out and back from each cheek.
cheek_spikes.paint: the two short cheek spikes as pale horn

feet_tilt: At the very bottom the front halves of the two feet stand on the floor far below, toes pointing at the bottom of the picture, each a broad foot front with four long toes that fan out and end in claws.
feet_paint: each foot front with four long toes ending in short dark claws
dome: scaled top of the skull, plated with rows of small scales and a low ridge of larger scutes down its middle
face_paint: the head as a scaled top of the skull seen from above with, in the narrow strip along its bottom edge, a natural draconian face strongly foreshortened from above, a scaled brow over small shadowed amber eyes and a broad blunt snout with two nostrils
note: The underside of the chest and the belly are a paler tan, plated with broad belly scutes.
notes: Legacy: heavy muscular dragon-woman, orange-rust scales (154,73,45), pale tan belly scutes, two pale swept horns, short cheek spikes, midline scute ridge on skull, amber eyes, clawed hands, 4 clawed toes, no hair, no tail.
